abstract: A series of 22 consecutive cases of thymic tumour was collected and the tumours were reclassified according to a modified classification scheme. Two-thirds of them were benign lympho-epitheliomas, though in one case pleural implants were noted. One-third of the tumours were clearly malignant (carcinomas, lymphomas and seminomas). In one of the seminomas and in a case of Hodgkin's disease of the thymus no signs of recurrence or metastases have been observed in 10 and 8 years respectively. The sex distribution was fairly equal except that all three seminomas were detected in young men. The malignant tumours usually gave rise to symptoms, while the benign ones did not. Four of the lympho-epitheliomas were associated with myasthenia gravis. No other associated syndrome was observed. The possibility that lympho-epitheliomas may be malignant is discussed.
abstract_ja: 連続した胸腺腫瘍22例を収集し、改訂分類法に従って腫瘍を再分類した。その3分の2は良性のリンパ上皮腫であったが、1例では胸膜播種が認められた。腫瘍の3分の1は明らかに悪性(癌腫、リンパ腫、セミノーマ)であった。セミノーマの1例と胸腺のホジキン病の1例では、それぞれ10年および8年にわたり再発や転移の兆候は認められていない。性別の分布はおおむね均等であったが、3例のセミノーマはすべて若年男性で検出された。悪性腫瘍は通常症状を呈したが、良性腫瘍は症状を呈さなかった。リンパ上皮腫4例は重症筋無力症を伴っていた。その他の関連症候群は認められなかった。リンパ上皮腫が悪性である可能性について考察する。
